function mopen(k,trig){cur=MAIL[k]||MAIL.walk;last=trig;mt.textContent=cur.h.replace(/ (\S+)$/,'\u00a0$1');mst.textContent='';
md.querySelector('[data-m=gmail]').href='https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to='+enc(ADDR)+'&su='+enc(cur.s)+'&body='+enc(cur.b);
md.querySelector('[data-m=outlook]').href='https://outlook.office.com/mail/deeplink/compose?to='+enc(ADDR)+'&subject='+enc(cur.s)+'&body='+enc(cur.b);
md.querySelector('[data-m=app]').href='mailto:'+ADDR+'?subject='+enc(cur.s)+'&body='+enc(cur.b);
md.hidden=false;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';md.querySelector('[data-m=gmail]').focus();}
function mclose(){md.hidden=true;document.body.style.overflow='';if(last)try{last.focus()}catch(e){}}
function copied(ok){mst.textContent=ok?'Copied. Paste brad@molinistudio.com into any email.':'Please copy this address: brad@molinistudio.com';}
root.querySelectorAll('[data-mail]').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();mopen(a.getAttribute('data-mail'),a)})});
md.querySelector('[data-m=app]').addEventListener('click',function(){mst.textContent='If nothing opens, choose Gmail or Outlook, or copy the address.'});
md.querySelector('[data-m=copy]').addEventListener('click',function(){var done=function(ok){copied(ok)};
try{if(navigator.clipboard&&window.isSecureContext){navigator.clipboard.writeText(ADDR).then(function(){done(true)},function(){done(fb())});return}}catch(e){}done(fb());});
function fb(){try{var ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=ADDR;ta.setAttribute('readonly','');ta.style.position='fixed';ta.style.opacity='0';md.appendChild(ta);ta.select();var ok=document.execCommand('copy');md.removeChild(ta);return ok}catch(e){return false}}
md.querySelector('[data-mclose]').addEventListener('click',mclose);
var lb=document.getElementById('mbv-lb'),wfb=root.querySelector('.wfb');
if(lb&&wfb){var lbi=lb.querySelector('img');function lbclose(){lb.hidden=true;document.body.style.overflow='';try{wfb.focus()}catch(e){}}
wfb.addEventListener('click',function(){lbi.src=wfb.querySelector('img').src;lb.hidden=false;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';lb.querySelector('[data-lbclose]').focus()});
lb.querySelector('[data-lbclose]').addEventListener('click',lbclose);
lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===lb)lbclose()});
lb.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'||e.key==='Tab'){e.preventDefault();if(e.key==='Escape')lbclose()}});}
md.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===md)mclose()});
md.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'){mclose();return}if(e.key==='Tab'){var f=md.querySelectorAll('a[href],button');var a=f[0],z=f[f.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===a){e.preventDefault();z.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===z){e.preventDefault();a.focus()}}});
})();
})();
